caption: The drawing features a rectangular wooden sign with a dark background, bordered by a thin lighter line and supported by two vertical posts, one at each upper corner. In the upper section of the sign, a large golden eagle with outstretched wings faces left, sitting atop a white globular object with line markings. The left side of the sign features a golden sun with rays radiating outward, while the right side displays a crescent moon and several small gold circular stars. The lower section of the sign contains the word "TEMPERANCE" in large, uppercase golden letters centered against the dark background. The wood is visibly worn with horizontal cracks running through the upper part of the sign.
title: Tavern Sign: "Temperance"
